steps.en: The court PDF file has been sent to the print vendor
steps.id: File PDF court sudah dikirim ke vendor cetak
steps.why_en: No court file is sent to any vendor.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada file court yang dikirim ke vendor mana pun.

steps.en: OCMS fills in the summons posting date on the notice
steps.id: OCMS mengisi tanggal posting summons di notice
steps.why_en: No code writes any posting date after sending.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada code yang menulis tanggal posting setelah pengiriman.

steps.en: Staff can see the summons posting date in OCMS
steps.id: Staff bisa melihat tanggal posting summons di OCMS
steps.why_en: The date field exists only in commented-out screen code; nothing is shown.
steps.why_id: Field tanggal hanya ada di kode layar yang di-comment; tidak ada yang tampil.
